targetText:
The law of contradiction in things, that is, the law of the unity of opposites,
is the basic law of materialist dialectics.
explanation: Change happens because everything contains opposing forces pushing against each other. For example, a business grows through the tension between keeping prices low for customers and earning enough profit to pay workers and upgrade tools.

targetText:
Our present study of
philosophy should therefore have the eradication of dogmatist thinking as
its main objective.
explanation: Mao argues that studying philosophy is meant to help us analyze real, concrete life rather than blindly copying textbook formulas (dogmatism). Real-life example: Applying a startup playbook from the 1990s to a modern app without adapting to today's users will fail.
